title: Numbering restarts pptx 001
notes: two text frames on one slide with bullets injected as raw XML (python-pptx has no bullet API): frame A carries a:buFont Arial + a:buChar '•' on all three paragraphs, frame B carries a:buAutoNum type=arabicPeriod on its three paragraphs. The numbering restart between frames is IMPLICIT: DrawingML autonumbering state is per text-body, so frame B starts at '1.' with no restart flag to set — unlike docx numbering-restarts there is no numId/level to continue or reset, and no cross-frame continue mode exists. Bullet glyphs and numbers are formatting, not text: reference_text lists the six paragraph strings only.
